svg.title: KS-14 animated top view
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping top view of KS-14 (Driver-initiated lane change) from its esmini replay at the parameter defaults, 0.0 to 8.8 s: The driver changes lane to the right, a car 2.5 s behind in the target lane. Plot: ego lateral position from the lane -2 centre (m). Events: driver starts the lane change (scripted here) at 3.0 s; ego crosses into lane -3 at 5.1 s; ego centred in lane -3, the car behind 2.5 s back at 6.8 s; loop ends at 8.8 s. Layer 2 fixes the road and the other road users. The ego's lane change is scripted in the file; in a closed loop the driver's nudge starts it. Cars: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
